scripts.build:cloudflare: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10 --activate && corepack pnpm install && corepack pnpm build
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && npx wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name website-insurance-broker
scripts.build:cloudflare-client: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10 --activate && corepack pnpm install && corepack pnpm --filter frontend build:portal-client
scripts.build:cloudflare-staff: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10 --activate && corepack pnpm install && corepack pnpm --filter frontend build:portal-staff
scripts.deploy:cloudflare-client: npm run build:cloudflare-client && npx wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name website-insurance-broker-client
scripts.deploy:cloudflare-staff: npm run build:cloudflare-staff && npx wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name website-insurance-broker-staff
